The five points from the review, and a pass over the sheet and the windows.

- **The right column steps off the sidebar's shard.** The status strip and the Projects tray are 280 px wide and the column sits 22 px further from the tiles, so nothing reads through the black shard.
- **Ink in the glass.** The coloured panes carry an ink texture now: dark veins wandering along the shear, a few pools where the ink settled, a darker grain over the streaks. Half of it is in the glass at all times, the rest comes up while the pane is lit. The audit page renders the same recipe.
- **The clock reads top-down.** Campaign in the title face, chapter and day dim and tracked, the phase in the state colour, the hour in Bone, "how long ago" small in the state colour, the room small and dim under a hairline.
- **Light on the launchers.** The messenger and settings rings light their seam under the cursor (and on keyboard focus); the Foundry tiles glow softly on hover.
- **The sheet's tiles are the audit's tile.** Actions, Hope Calls and Despair Calls: the edge in the tile's colour (state, Hope gold, Despair pink, GM red), the brush on hover and on the chosen one, dashed when out of reach, the pixel glyph above the name, the cost small and dim.
- **Windows.** Section heads are quiet caps over a hairline in the state colour, body text in the prose face at 17 px, notes dim; the chosen table row takes the brush, Foundry's window controls on module windows lose their plate, the scrollbar takes the theme's colour. The sheet's name is set in the title face and the header band's text stands on a shadow.
- Icons stay per theme: pixel glyphs under Stained Glass, Font Awesome under Monokuma Legacy.
